name: bizplug-property-management
description: The property management plug-in from BizPlug. Main function: maintenance requests and status. It works from the business's own published profile, covering available rentals, maintenance requests and policies, and sends requests to the business to confirm. It never takes payment and only shares what the business has published. Provided by BizPlug: https://www.bizplug.ai, info@bizplug.ai.
